speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
title: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Bishop Sean Douglas spoke about “The Hour of Your Mission Is Come”.

quotes.text: As a member of the Presiding Bishopric, I have the privilege of serving on the Church’s Missionary Executive Council. I have a deep love for the missionaries of the Church. They are uniquely set apart from the world and divinely commissioned by the Savior. As President Dallin H. Oaks teaches: “We invite all [of God’s children] to come unto Christ by repentance and baptism and confirmation in order to open the doors of the celestial kingdom to the sons and daughters of God. No one else can do this.” Missionaries are called to assist in this great work.
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: A few months ago, I attended a sacrament meeting where my two great-nephews, who are brothers, spoke before departing for their missions. They were beaming with enthusiasm and eager to get going. Maybe it was because their assignments are thousands of miles from home at opposite ends of the earth. But in truth, their desire to serve the Lord was unmistakable.
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: God held you in reserve for this time. You were taught and prepared, before you were born, to invite God’s children to come unto Christ. We could say this is in your spiritual DNA. Take care not to become distracted. Prioritize it; don’t let anything get in the way. You are needed!
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: With the help of friends and leaders, Merlin returned to church at age 25. A desire to serve a mission suddenly swelled in his heart. Thankfully, his mission papers were well advanced. Once he made the decision to go, it was miraculous to see how the Lord removed seemingly insurmountable obstacles one by one. When I asked him why he wanted to serve, he replied, “I only want to be close to Jesus Christ and to follow Him.”
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: He became a wonderful missionary, converted to Jesus Christ and His doctrine. His every experience, trial, and companion was consecrated for his gain. Interestingly, Elder Sanchez served with the same companion twice, for a total of eight months. Though opposite in personality, they became united in purpose—assigned together by divine design.
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Merlin and Gali today have a beautiful family with three children, while Merlin serves as a stake president. They cannot fathom what their lives would be if Merlin had not served a mission.
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Prophets of God today strongly reaffirm “that the Lord has asked every worthy, able young man to prepare for and serve a mission. For [you], missionary service is a priesthood responsibility. … For you young and able sisters, a mission is also a powerful, but optional, opportunity. … Pray to know if the Lord would have you serve a mission.”
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: You have a testimony of Jesus Christ and His Atonement that can bless a world suffering without knowledge of His divine mission. I pray that you will make the Savior’s grand commission your very own.
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
